stories.stat_label: years old: oldest Mars lava rock
stories.headline: A Sahara meteorite is the oldest lava rock from Mars
stories.summary: Tiny zircon crystals date the meteorite Teghaza 001 to 4.1 billion years, the oldest Mars igneous rock found by a huge margin. It holds manganese oxide, a sign of wetter conditions.
stories.why: It's a rare sample of Mars' earliest crust, when the planet may have been more Earth-like.

stories.headline: Charcoal shows Neanderthals tidied their campfires
stories.summary: At Abric Romaní, a rock shelter used from 110,000 to 40,000 years ago, mapped charcoal shows one main ash heap by the hearths and smaller piles, likely from cleaning them out.
stories.why: Bits of burnt wood reveal how Neanderthals organised their homes, much like we do.

stories.stat_label: the veteran went without a car
stories.headline: Students rebuilt a wrecked car and gave it to a veteran
stories.summary: Collision-repair students at Dunwoody College spent months fixing a crashed 2020 Hyundai Elantra, then handed it to Navy veteran Robert Hanson, who had been walking everywhere for food.
stories.why: He called it a big-time game changer: he can finally shop and get out to enjoy life again.

stories.headline: Camera traps found 607 species around Vietnam's My Son temples
stories.summary: 30 camera traps in the forest around the ancient Cham temples caught Javan pangolins, civets, porcupines and monkeys. Surveys logged 607 animal species and 238 plant species.
stories.why: The 1,160-hectare forest protects both a World Heritage site and rare wildlife.

fun_fact: Of the 607 species logged at My Son, 189 are bottom-dwelling water animals.
